search_text: $S_1^2=\frac1{n-1}\sum(X_i-\bar X)^2,S_2^2=\frac1n\sum(X_i-\bar X)^2$等，哪个统计量服从$t(n-1)$？ $\sqrt{n-1}(\bar X-\mu)/S_2$ $\sqrt{n-1}(\bar X-\mu)/S_1$ $\sqrt{n-1}(\bar X-\mu)/S_3$ $\sqrt{n-1}(\bar X-\mu)/S_4$ $S_2^2=\sum residual^2/n$，对应$t$统计量为$\sqrt{n-1}(\bar X-\mu)/S_2$。
